question: With the core engaged, does DNg100_L stimulation produce a front-left motor rhythm that is specific to DNg100 (versus control DNs) and needs E1, E2 and I1?
not_claimed: anything about the live LIF engine
a change to motor admission or mappings
anticipated: R2 reported (untested) MN rhythm scores 0.01-0.03 in every engaged condition; R3's DNG100 outcome is partly anticipated. R3 adds controls, silencing, fresh seeds, criteria and core-trace rhythmicity.

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

model: R1's model unchanged (dng100_rate_model: network, W, draw, scale, simulate; b 0.03; RK45 rtol 2e-6 atol 5e-9; 1 s; onset 20 ms; window t = 250..999 ms); silencing holds the cell's activation at 0 (as R1). No drive adjustment.

conditions.drive_rule: per arm, R2's lowest ladder drive at which all three core cells were engaged in >= 8 of 16 seeds (chosen from R2's engagement data, not its rhythm scores)

VNCSIZE.sizes: R1b cord-only, computed as in R2 (dng100_recruitment_map.cord_only_sizes)

conditions.per_arm: DNG100 (DNg100_L stimulated) seeds 1001-1064; SIL_E1, SIL_E2, SIL_I1 (DNg100_L stimulated, one core cell silenced) seeds 1001-1064 each; CONTROL x 20 (each control DN stimulated at the arm's drive) seeds 1001-1016 each
conditions.controls_note: R1's 20 acetylcholine control DNs (rng 20261107), unchanged; 129181 is also one of E1's two-hop intermediates (reported, not changed)
conditions.order: I2 reproduction first; then VNCSIZE, then R1SIZE; within an arm DNG100, SIL_E1, SIL_E2, SIL_I1, then controls in the listed order

readout.replicate: R1's score_rates: V1 rhythmicity per active front-left MN (max > 0.01 Hz), mean over active MNs (NaN if none); frequency = median 1000/period over active MNs with score > 0
readout.condition: R1's summarize: mean score over replicates with a score; median frequency
readout.engaged: all three of E1, E2, I1 active (max > 0.01 Hz) in the window

acceptance.C1_rhythm: DNG100 score >= 0.5 AND > 80th percentile of the 20 control scores
acceptance.C3_necessity: SIL_E1, SIL_E2 and SIL_I1 each score < 0.5
acceptance.RATE_RHYTHM_PARTIAL: C1 and (not C2 or not C3)
acceptance.INCONCLUSIVE: I1, I2 or I4 failure, or no DNG100 replicate with a score
acceptance.qualifier: CORE_NOT_RELIABLY_ENGAGED if fewer than half of the arm's DNG100 replicates are engaged

reported_not_gated: rhythmicity of the E1, E2 and I1 rate traces themselves (when active)
Ti flexor vs Ti extensor cross-correlation lag (tibia_phase)
recruited counts, stimulated-neuron rate, per-MN score and period with muscle names
engagement and core activity fractions per condition

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; control list equal and in the network; R1b z* = 462 and m_VNC = 507,457,760 reproduced
integrity.I2_r2_reproduction: hard gate before any protocol condition: DNg100_L at each arm's drive, seeds 1-4, must match R2's result.json exactly (recruited count, E1/E2/I1 active, MN score); failure stops the run as INCONCLUSIVE
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_dng100_engaged_rhythm.py passes (condition builder, summary, verdict and qualifier, expectations, I2 check)

expectations.X3: median E1 trace rhythmicity in VNCSIZE DNG100 < 0.5
expectations.note: recorded in the design before any R3 simulation, informed by R2's reported scores (disclosed); wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration one VNCSIZE DNG100 simulation at seed 0 (not a protocol seed) was run for wall time only (0.74 s; also printed z* 462, m_VNC and source hashes); its score and rates were not printed.
execution: one command (--output) runs I2 and all 1,152 simulations and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once in the background.
interpretation_limits: Isolated 2,111-neuron network (R1's); no other brain or cord input.
Drives chosen by a declared engagement rule, outside the preprint's 5-500 recruitment rule; the engaged state has ~600+ active neurons.
Reconstructed rate model (b from ratenet.js); 64 replicates, not 1,024; 68 bodymap MNs, not MANC's 144.
The V1 rhythmicity score is our measure, not the preprint's analysis.
Outcome partly anticipated by R2's reported scores.
Neural only: no body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
